description: This file declares the Controller class within the rialto::servermanager::ipc namespace, which implements the IController interface for managing IPC clients and configurations in the Rialto server manager component.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: Implements the IController interface to manage IPC clients, perform configuration, ping, and state operations, and handle log levels within the Rialto server manager.

methods.name: Controller
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Controller with a reference to ISessionServerAppManager.

methods.name: createClient
methods.description: Creates a new client with specified server ID and application management socket.

methods.name: removeClient
methods.description: Removes the client associated with the specified server ID.

methods.name: performSetConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the configuration for a server, including initial state, socket name, display name, resource capabilities, and socket permissions.

methods.name: performPing
methods.description: Performs a ping operation to check server responsiveness.

methods.name: performSetState
methods.description: Sets the session server state for a given server ID.

methods.name: setLogLevels
methods.description: Sets the logging levels for the service.
